$comment: CA bundle canonical signing input (the bytes that get Ed25519-signed). The transport encoding is JSON; this CBOR encoding is ONLY used as the signature input.

encoding_rules.bytes: major type 2 (NOT the typed-array tag RFC 8746)
encoding_rules.maps: major type 5; outer integer keys 1..6 in numeric order; inner 'keys' map's text keys sorted bytewise per RFC 8949 §4.2 (shorter first; equal-length compared bytewise)

vectors.name: bundle_with_prev_key
vectors.description: Two-key bundle during a rotation window. master-k1 is active; master-k0 is the previous key still accepted for one window.

inputs.$note: Inner 'keys' map is canonically sorted: 'master-k0' < 'master-k1' bytewise; both have equal length 9 so byte-by-byte comparison applies.

vectors.name: bundle_single_key
vectors.description: Steady-state bundle: one active key, no prev. prevKeyId is encoded as the empty text string (the JSON field MAY be absent on the wire; the CBOR canonical input MUST carry the empty-string placeholder at key 5).
